title: Finite pullback factors through open cohomology compatibly with restricted units
statement: Let f:X→Y be any scheme morphism, y∈Y, F an O_X-module, p,n≥0, I an injective resolution of F, K one of F′=g′*F and J one of F_n=i_n*F, where g′:Spec O_y×_Y X→X and i_n:X_n→X [def-weil-pbc-formal-functions-finite-pullback,def-weil-pbc-formal-fibre-cohomology]. Let V⊆Y be any open, E local-base-change open choices and D finite-base-change open choices for I,K,J,V [def-weil-pbc-flat-base-change-open-choices]. Write U=f⁻¹V, U′=g′⁻¹U, W=i_n⁻¹U. There exists an additive map t:H^p(U′,F′|U′)→H^p(W,F_n|W) such that (1) for every z∈H^p(X′,F′), t(res_U′ z)=res_W(formalFunctionsFinitePullback z), and (2) for every xi∈H^p(U,F|U), t(moduleCohomologyFMap(g′|U′,E.psi,p)(xi))=moduleCohomologyFMap(i_n|W,D.psi,p)(xi) [def-weil-pbc-module-cohomology-fmap]. No germ, stalk comparison, properness, coherence or Noetherianity is assumed.

source.place: Tag 02OD, proof: c_n factors through c; Tags 01F7 and 01FB: composition and restriction of cohomology h-maps (read at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/02OD and /01FB).

proof.text: Put g′=pullback.snd(c,f), j=formalFunctionsFiniteι, U=f⁻¹V, U′=g′⁻¹U, W=i_n⁻¹U. The proved projection identity j≫g′=i_n gives W=j⁻¹U′. Apply moduleCohomologyFMap_restriction to j and formalFunctionsFiniteFMap at U′. Transport the restricted target along W=j⁻¹U′, and take the induced cohomology map as t. Its restriction square gives t(res_U′ z)=res_W(formalFunctionsFinitePullback z) for every z.

Transpose formalFunctionsFiniteFMap under the specified tensorPullback adjunction; apply_symm_apply identifies its transpose with the i_n-unit, transported across the projection equality and pushforward composition. Restrict to W and substitute E.unit_square and D.unit_square. Both the composite of E.psi with the restricted finite h-map and D.psi transpose under the U-restriction adjunction to this same restricted i_n-unit. Naturality of pushforwardComp and pushforwardCongr gives the identifications, and injectivity of the restriction homEquiv gives equality of these h-maps. Apply moduleCohomologyFMap_comp and transport along the equality of their underlying scheme maps to obtain t(E.psi* xi)=D.psi* xi. The construction uses no stalk or germ, no hy, and no coherent/proper/Noetherian hypotheses. Degree zero is section-map composition; zero modules and empty opens give zero maps.

theorem formalFunctions_finite_open_factorization {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (y : Y) (F : X.Modules) (p n : ℕ) (I : InjectiveResolution F)
    (K : InjectiveResolution
      ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.snd (Y.fromSpecStalk y) f)).obj F))
    (J : InjectiveResolution ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (formalFibreι f y n)).obj F))
    (V : Y.Opens)
    (E : Scheme.Modules.FlatBaseChangeOpenChoices f (Y.fromSpecStalk y) F I K V)
    (D : Scheme.Modules.FlatBaseChangeOpenChoices f (formalFibreBaseMap Y y n) F I J V) :
    ∃ t : (forget₂ _ AddCommGrpCat.{u}).obj
        ((RingedSpace.moduleCohomology
          ((pullback.snd (Y.fromSpecStalk y) f) ⁻¹ᵁ (f ⁻¹ᵁ V)).toScheme.toRingedSpace p).obj
          ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor
            ((pullback.snd (Y.fromSpecStalk y) f) ⁻¹ᵁ (f ⁻¹ᵁ V)).ι).obj
            ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.snd (Y.fromSpecStalk y) f)).obj F))) →+
      (forget₂ _ AddCommGrpCat.{u}).obj
        ((RingedSpace.moduleCohomology
          ((formalFibreι f y n) ⁻¹ᵁ (f ⁻¹ᵁ V)).toScheme.toRingedSpace p).obj
          ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor ((formalFibreι f y n) ⁻¹ᵁ (f ⁻¹ᵁ V)).ι).obj
            ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (formalFibreι f y n)).obj F))),
      (∀ z : formalFunctionsLocalCohomology f y F p,
        t (Scheme.Modules.moduleCohomologyRestriction
          ((pullback.snd (Y.fromSpecStalk y) f) ⁻¹ᵁ (f ⁻¹ᵁ V))
          ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.snd (Y.fromSpecStalk y) f)).obj F) p z) =
        Scheme.Modules.moduleCohomologyRestriction ((formalFibreι f y n) ⁻¹ᵁ (f ⁻¹ᵁ V))
          ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (formalFibreι f y n)).obj F) p
          (formalFunctionsFinitePullback f y F p n z)) ∧
      (∀ xi : (forget₂ _ AddCommGrpCat.{u}).obj
          ((RingedSpace.moduleCohomology (f ⁻¹ᵁ V).toScheme.toRingedSpace p).obj
            ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (f ⁻¹ᵁ V).ι).obj F)),
        t (Scheme.Modules.moduleCohomologyFMap
          ((pullback.snd (Y.fromSpecStalk y) f).resLE (f ⁻¹ᵁ V)
            ((pullback.snd (Y.fromSpecStalk y) f) ⁻¹ᵁ (f ⁻¹ᵁ V)) le_rfl) E.psi p xi) =
        Scheme.Modules.moduleCohomologyFMap ((formalFibreι f y n).resLE (f ⁻¹ᵁ V)
          ((formalFibreι f y n) ⁻¹ᵁ (f ⁻¹ᵁ V)) le_rfl) D.psi p xi)
